name: Minibike
description: A two-wheel motor vehicle with wheels under 14 inches, an engine under 45 cc, under 3 horsepower or rated under 2,238 W, or one its manufacturer designed for off-road use only: both a low-powered electric two-wheeler that isn't a moped and a dirt e-moto at any power. It's kept off the streets rather than registered. Defined by Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-636, as amended by LB 97 (2025), which added the horsepower and wattage tests.

restrictions.rule: A two-wheel motor vehicle meeting any one test: wheels and tires under 14 inches, an engine under 45 cc, under 3 horsepower, a rating under 2,238 W, or designed by its manufacturer for off-road use only
LB 97, in force since April 14, 2025, added the horsepower and wattage tests, so a two-wheel motor vehicle under 2,238 W is a minibike whatever it's built for
Sold with a notice that it's for off-road use only
A new one must be titled
Exempt from the operator's license, registration and safety responsibility (insurance) laws
Can't be ridden on any state highway; state law means to remove minibikes from street use, allowing only a crossing or turnaround on a street
State park and recreation area managers may allow it in designated places and times and set speed, age and noise limits; riding outside them is a Class III misdemeanor
Any state agency or local government may permit or ban it on land it owns or controls
